hints.title: Bounded Coordinate Space
hints.text: All tower coordinates are between 0 and 50, limiting the search area to a 51 by 51 grid.

hints.title: Compute Quality per Candidate
hints.text: For each point, sum floor of q divided by (1 + d) for all towers within Euclidean distance of radius.

hints.title: Tie Breaking
hints.text: Iterate through coordinates in row-major order so ties automatically favor lexicographically smaller coordinates.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: X and Y are coordinate bounds (51 each)
